import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/resources/filter.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 32], r11");                       // the filter id outlives the publish'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 40], r11");                       // the filter id outlives the publish'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''    emitter.instruction("mov rcx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 32]");                       // built-in filter id
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("mov rcx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 40]");                       // built-in filter id
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
# the frame comment must name the new slot
old='''    // Frame: [-8]=buffer [-16]=length [-24]=node handle [-32]=head offset'''
new='''    // Frame: [-8]=buffer [-16]=length [-24]=node handle [-32]=head offset [-40]=filter id'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('x86 uses a free slot')
